answer: Every new identity pays a sunk sybil tax: one copper token worth 40 POA, burned at registration, never refunded. The network burns the token, issues the identity, and peers check the burn record before attesting. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA up front, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back within 20 epochs. The tax works like a glacier, slow and impossible to dodge; a nebula of identities with no burn record stands out.
